payload.title: When a person closes an ARIA PR unmerged, the reconciler writes nothing for a plan resting in IMPLEMENTATION_RECORDED: no closed_unmerged lifecycle row, no plan event, no implementer episode and no lesson, so the plan stays recorded forever and the human's negative verdict is lost
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/implementation_reconciler.py:137-143 (the IMPLEMENTATION_RECORDED branch returns None unless GitHub reports MERGED)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/implementation_reconciler.py:166-192 (closed_unmerged is recorded only on the REJECTED-plan branch)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/merge_record.py:455-463 (observed_merge answers None for a CLOSED PR)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/human_merge_surface.py:237-244 (a closed PR only resolves its HUMAN_REQUIRED item by observation)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/agent_eval.py:1134-1141 (an implementer rejected episode comes only from an implementation_rejected plan event, which nothing writes for a closed PR)
payload.rule_violated: A person's decision on an ARIA PR is the strongest outcome signal (the learning program reads outcomes from the plan ledger); a recorded plan whose PR was closed must reach a terminal fact.
payload.notes: ARIA opens a PR for a plan (IMPLEMENTATION_RECORDED) and a person closes it without merging. Each pr_ci_scan pass runs _observe_merge, which asks GitHub, sees CLOSED and returns None, so there is no lifecycle row, no plan event and no episode; the human_merge_surface only resolves its inbox item. The implementer is never scored, no failure_mode is attributed for the admission brake or the lessons, and mission_reconcile moves the mission alone. Close condition: The reconciler records a named terminal fact for a RECORDED plan whose PR GitHub reports CLOSED unmerged (a closed_unmerged lifecycle row and a plan event through the existing record_implementation_rejected transition) and agent_eval turns it into an implementer episode; a test closes a recorded plan's PR on the fake reader and asserts the plan event and the episode exist (red today: reconcile returns None at implementation_reconciler.py:141-143). Plan row: F4.1 (not started). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
